description: This file defines the Smtp class within the Opencart System Library Mail namespace. It implements SMTP email sending functionality, including connection handling, authentication, message composition, and attachment processing.

classes.name: Smtp
classes.description: A class responsible for sending emails via SMTP protocol, supporting features like TLS, attachments, custom headers, and server communication handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SMTP object with configuration options, setting default values when not provided.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and transmits an email message through an SMTP server, handling connection, authentication, headers, attachments, and server responses.

methods.name: handleReply
methods.description: Reads server responses during SMTP communication, ensuring expected reply codes are received, with support for retries and error handling.
